key_insight: TrialDesignBench finds that five frontier LLMs fall short of expert-validated, contemporary standards for early-phase oncology trial design.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark supports research toward AI-assisted dose-finding trial design aligned with recent FDA initiatives, including Project Optimus.
method: Paired each trial with an expert-validated reference design using a formalized expert process.
Evaluated five frontier LLMs and tested sources of performance gaps through ablations.
evidence_signal: Supplying latent design determinants improved class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22, while structured decision-tree reasoning improved it by 0.24.
watch_item: Benchmark performance does not establish clinical readiness; important design determinants may be absent from trial records.
paper_title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
